ENAC-TALK x Ennovate ’23: a conversation with The Burger Company

1 February 2023 · By Enactus ARSD

ENAC-TALK returned alongside Ennovate ’23 as the chapter’s speaker session for February — held on campus on 10 February 2023 from 10 a.m.

The speaker

The session featured Neelam Singh, founder of The Burger Company, speaking about building a food business from scratch — the choices, setbacks and persistence behind it.

Part of a bigger programme

ENAC-TALK continues a tradition the chapter started with Ennovate ’20, its first Enactus Day on 5 February 2020 — which combined a panel discussion, case-study competition, quiz and ad-enacting event.

Registrations for the 2023 session were handled through the chapter’s official channels and closed ahead of the event.

This story is based on the chapter's own published update — read the original ↗
